source:
@@U01041@@
The drink won't harm him; we're friends; and he’s a man of many degrees of imbibing, a man who's taken many a healthy swallow. (With considerable ceremony, the WITCH pours the potion into a bowl, and as 浮士德 brings it to his lips a faint flame rises from it.)

@@U01043@@
All the way now! Do it, down we go! There! It'll do your heart good. You claim to be friends with the Devil, and you're afraid of a little fire?

@@U01044@@
(The WITCH breaks the circle. 浮士德 steps out.)

@@U01045@@
Quickly now! Let’s go! You mustn‘ rest.

@@U01047@@
May that little swallow do you much good!

@@U01049@@
(To the WITCH.)

@@U01050@@
If ever I can do you a favor, mention it to me some 瓦尔普吉斯 Night.

@@U01052@@
(Handing 浮士德 a song on a broadsheet.)

@@U01053@@
Here's a song you might enjoy singing, sir. For when you do, you'll notice a certain tingling here and there.

@@U01055@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U01056@@
Hurry now, come with me! You must work up a sweat so the potion’s force will work on you inside and out. I'll teach you then to treasure the life of noble idleness, and soon you'll feel the deep delight of Cupid stirring and leaping in you every which way!
translation:
@@U01041@@
酒不会伤害他；我们是朋友；他是一个善于饮酒的人，一个健康地喝过很多酒的人。 （女巫以相当大的仪式将药水倒入碗中，浮士德将其送到唇边时，其中升起了微弱的火焰。）

@@U01043@@
现在一路走好！做吧，我们下去！那里！这会对你的心脏有好处。你自称是魔鬼的朋友，还怕一点火？

@@U01044@@
（女巫打破了圆圈。浮士德走了出来。）

@@U01045@@
现在快点！我们走吧！你必须休息。

@@U01047@@
愿那只小燕子对你有好处！

@@U01049@@
（对女巫。）

@@U01050@@
如果我能帮你一个忙，请在瓦尔普吉斯之夜向我提起。

@@U01052@@
（递给浮士德一首大报上的歌曲。）

@@U01053@@
先生，这是一首您可能喜欢唱的歌。因为当你这样做时，你会注意到到处都有某种刺痛感。

@@U01055@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U01056@@
快点，跟我来吧！你必须出汗，这样药水的力量才能从内到外作用于你。那么我就教你珍惜高尚闲散的生活，很快你就会感受到丘比特在你身上各个方面的激动和跳跃的深深喜悦！
